                                                                                                              VH CONNECTOR

   Model number allocation

Headers with posts omitted (standard type)

  1）Polarized header (N-1) with post omitted                           Example） Circuit No.   1   2   3   4   5   6   7
     However, this only applies when 4 posts or more are used                    Circuit (post) ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ × ○ ○: with post
                                                                                 Model No.      B6P7-VH       ×: without post
            B＊1 P＊2 -VH

  2）Polarized header with circuit No. 2 post omitted                   Example） Circuit No.   1   2   3   4   5   6   7
     However, this only applies when 4 posts or more are used
                                                                                 Circuit (post) ○ × ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○: with post
                                                                                                              ×: without post
            B＊1 P＊2 -VH-L                                                        Model No.      B6P7-VH-L



  3）Header with pitch size doubled by omitting even numbered posts
     However, this only applies if the total number of circuits
     (including circuits without posts) is an odd number.

          ①Header with pitch size doubled (7.92 mm)                    Example） Circuit No.   1   2   3   4   5   6   7
                                                                                 Circuit (post) ○ × ○ × ○ × ○ ○: with post
            B＊1 P＊2 -VH                                                          Model No.      B4P7-VH       ×: without post


          ②Header with pitch size tripled (11.88 mm)                   Example） Circuit No.   1   2   3   4   5   6   7
                                                                                 Circuit (post) ○ × × ○ × × ○ ○: with post
            B＊1 P＊2 -VH                                                          Model No.      B3P7-VH       ×: without post


          ③Header with pitch size quadrupled (15.84 mm)                Example） Circuit No.   1   2   3   4   5   6   7   8   9
                                                                                 Circuit (post) ○ × × × ○ × × × ○ ○: with post
            B＊1 P＊2 -VH                                                          Model No.      B3P9-VH           ×: without post


Note) ＊1: Actual number of circuits (actual number of posts)
      ＊2: Total number of circuits (including post-omitted circuits)
